BrepArrayStructure.doc: Validates Brep-level attributes of a UsdSolid BrepArray: required attributes are authored, the brep:intersectTol3d, brep:regionCount and brep:extent array sizes are mutually consistent with the number of Breps, intersectTol3d values are positive, and each brep:extent bounding box is min<=max ordered.

BrepArrayTopology.doc: Validates that the flat-packed Radial Edge topology arrays of a UsdSolid BrepArray have consistent sizes: each level (region, shell, faceuse, face, loop, edgeuse, edge, wireEdge, vertex) must have array sizes derived from the counts at the level above it.

BrepArrayTokenValues.doc: Validates that token-valued attributes of a UsdSolid BrepArray (region:type, shell:pointType, faceuse:orientationType, face:surfaceType, face:trimType, edgeuse:orientationType, edgeuse:thisRadialEntryType, edge:curveType, wireEdge:curveType, vertex:pointType) only contain values from their allowed token sets.

BrepArrayRanges.doc: Validates parameter ranges of a UsdSolid BrepArray: face:loopCount is at least one, face:range U and V intervals are non-degenerate, and edge:range / wireEdge:range pairs are ordered (min<=max).

BrepArrayFaceOuterLoop.doc: Validates proposal #109 rule 424/425 on a UsdSolid BrepArray: each face has a single outer loop, and the first loop listed is that outer loop, which must contain at least one edgeuse (seam edges are required). Flags faces whose first/outer loop has loop:edgeuseCount == 0 (an edgeless periodic surface such as a cylinder/sphere/cone authored as a single seamless NURBS patch). A zero-edgeuse vertex-loop is legal only as a degenerate inner (non-first) loop, so inner loops are not flagged.

BrepArrayAnalyticSurfaces.doc: Validates analytic surface parameters of a UsdSolid BrepArray (plane, cylinder, cone, sphere, torus): the parameter arrays match the number of faces of that surface type, radii are positive, axis and refDirection are unit-length and mutually orthogonal, and cone semiAngle lies in (0, pi/2).

BrepArrayAuthorship.doc: Validates that every per-family schema attribute (region, shell, faceuse, face, loop, edgeuse, edge, wireEdge, vertex) is authored on a UsdSolid BrepArray prim.

BrepArrayDataTypes.doc: Validates that authored attributes of a UsdSolid BrepArray (including the BrepPointAPI vertexPoint/shellPoint position attributes) use the correct USD value types.

BrepArraySchemaUsage.doc: Validates two-way consistency between applied API schemas (BrepPointAPI:vertexPoint and the analytic BrepSurface*API schemas) and the corresponding face:surfaceType / vertex:pointType usage and authored data on a UsdSolid BrepArray.

BrepArrayReferences.doc: Validates that topological cross-reference indices of a UsdSolid BrepArray (faceuse->face, loop->vertex, edgeuse->edge, edgeuse->edgeuse radial, edge->vertex, wireEdge->vertex) fall within the owning Brep's partition.

BrepArrayCompleteness.doc: Validates Brep graph integrity of a UsdSolid BrepArray: every face is referenced by exactly two faceuses, the radial edgeuse chains close into cycles, and no edge is orphaned (every edge is referenced by at least one edgeuse).

BrepArrayContainment.doc: Validates spatial containment on a UsdSolid BrepArray: each brep:extent box lies within the prim's extent, and vertex positions and NURBS control points lie within their owning Brep's brep:extent box.

BrepArraySpans.doc: Validates parametric-domain limits on analytic geometry of a UsdSolid BrepArray: periodic surface/curve domains (sphere/cylinder/cone/torus faces, circle/ellipse edges) span at most 2*pi, and sphere latitude lies within [-pi/2, pi/2].

BrepArrayAnalyticCurves.doc: Validates analytic curve parameters of a UsdSolid BrepArray (circle, line, ellipse for edge and wireEdge instances): parameter arrays match the number of edges of that curve type, radii are positive, axis/refDirection/direction are unit-length, and axis and refDirection are orthogonal.

BrepArrayNurbs.doc: Validates NURBS geometry coherence of a UsdSolid BrepArray (surface, edge3d, wireEdge3d, curveUv): array sizes, orders positive and >= 2, order <= vertexCount, control-vertex/weight/knot vector sizes, positive weights, non-decreasing knot vectors, and schema/data usage consistency.

BrepArraySolidClosure.doc: Validates that a UsdSolid BrepArray region declared solidRegion has a closed bounding shell: every non-degenerate edge on a solid shell is shared by at least two edgeuses whose radial ring links them. Single-use (laminar/identity-ring) boundary edges are legal only on a voidRegion-only sheet/wire model, not on a solid. Degenerate pole/apex edges (start vertex == end vertex) are exempt.

BrepArrayDegenerateEdges.doc: Validates proposal rule 381 (degenerate geometry is not allowed, measured against tolerance) on a UsdSolid BrepArray: flags any edge or wireEdge whose 3D curve has no extent. For NURBS curves this means all control vertices coincide within brep:intersectTol3d; for analytic curves (line/circle/ellipse) it means zero arc length. Catches the collapsed apex/pole edges left when a periodic surface is authored with an all-equal-control-point seam.

BrepArrayEdgeCurveVertices.doc: Validates proposal rule 434 (the curve runs from the start vertex to the end vertex) on a UsdSolid BrepArray: for each edge and wireEdge, the 3D curve evaluated at its parametric endpoints must match the positions of the vertices named by its vertexIndices, in that order, within brep:intersectTol3d. Flags edge:vertexIndices authored in topological rather than curve-parametric order (reversed edges). Degenerate edges (start vertex == end vertex) are exempt.
